title: The hospital parking lot
logline: Never named. Wood in the Datsun in a lot with a different kind of sign. Five dailies; the book takes this one.

panels.composition: A parking lot in Newport, December, rain. A sign, its words cropped by the panel edge — only 'VISITOR' shows. The Datsun. WOOD inside with BARNABY.
props: a low institutional building, edge of panel

image.prompt: an old Datsun in a rainy parking lot in front of a low institutional building cropped by the panel edge, a sign showing only the word VISITOR, a young man and a small dog inside the car, muddy watercolor
image.notes: Never the word hospital. VISITOR and the building's edge. Letter after.

panels.composition: Wood, the pad on the wheel. Not drawing. The pad blank.

image.prompt: close-up of a blank drawing pad resting on a steering wheel, a young man's hands still on it, rain on the windshield

panels.composition: The dog's chin on his arm.

image.prompt: a small dog resting its chin on a young man's forearm inside a parked car, rain, no words

panels.composition: The lot. The Datsun, small. The building, still cropped. The sign. Nothing happens. This is the whole daily.

image.prompt: a wide rainy parking lot with a small old Datsun parked before a cropped institutional building and a VISITOR sign, nothing happening, muddy watercolor, no words

art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays in watercolor, improving

notes: The father's illness, rendered as a parking lot. The strip never enters the building.
